body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> iLuv unveiled its new 2.1-channel Hi-Fi audio system for iPod ‘i399’ during CES 2008.

The ‘i399’, the first iLuv product to feature the newest BluePin II technology, is offering even more freedom from up to 300 ft. With the detachable BluePin II, users can listen to music on Bluetooth headphones or send music from another stereo Bluetooth device to the i399.

Designed with patented jAura sound cell technology and featuring a woofer built into its 2.1 channel speaker system, the i399 produces a more authentic and richer audio sound. It also includes speaker phone capabilities for incoming and outgoing calls as well as a rhythm-sensitive blue LED light.
Finishing touches include FM stereo radio capabilities, digital clock display and an auxiliary line input for 1st, 2nd and 3rd generations of iPod and other audio devices.
